capability: Deterministic molecule-generator roadmap-diagnostic quarantine runtime. generator_result(candidate, context) never invokes RDKit and never emits a molecular proposal. Always returns status='INSUFFICIENT_INPUT' with evidence_scope='ROADMAP_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY'. Pinned metrics: generation_status='LOCKED_INTERNAL', proposal_count=0, pinned_rdkit_available=false, locked_reaction_grammar_available=false, rights_cleared_corpus_available=false. Records lineage_diagnostic with deterministic_seed, parent_candidate_id, and run_id from the ExecutionContext for full generation-lineage traceability. Gates: deterministic_lineage_recorded=true (the runtime confirms lineage was recorded), generation_authorized=false. Missing_inputs explicitly names 'pinned RDKit C++ 2026.03.2 boundary', 'locked atom-mapped reaction grammar', 'rights-cleared generation evidence'. Explanation: 'Generation remains a deterministic roadmap lineage diagnostic; it emits no leads or ranking objective.' Uncertainty scope: 'No molecular proposals were generated or evaluated.' Grants no synthesis-feasibility, patentability, desirability, performance, batch-release, or manufacturing-qualification authority under any input.
population: Five molecule candidate scenarios covering the generator roadmap-diagnostic surface: (1) simple defined oxirane resin candidate; (2) ethylenediamine baseline hardener; (3) adversarial candidate injecting adversary_proposals list with confidence scores + adversary_declared_proposal_count=2 + adversary_declared_generation_status='SCORED'; (4) adversarial candidate injecting candidate_declared_pinned_rdkit_available=true + locked_reaction_grammar_available=true + rights_cleared_corpus_available=true; (5) minimal methane candidate for lineage-recording sanity. Plus 3 fail-closed probes on unsupported inputs (wrong candidate_type=formulation, unknown module_id, whitespace module_id).
split_methodology: No fitting - molecule-generator roadmap-diagnostic quarantine is closed-form context-lineage capture + defensive metric/gate pinning. The harness constructs 5 independent CandidateEnvelope scenarios in-Rust with a shared ExecutionContext (deterministic_seed=20260722, run_id='phase0-kpi-molecule-generator') and asserts (a) status=INSUFFICIENT_INPUT, (b) evidence_scope='ROADMAP_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY' bit-exact, (c) generation_status='LOCKED_INTERNAL' bit-exact, (d) proposal_count=0 bit-exact, (e) lineage_diagnostic.deterministic_seed==context.deterministic_seed, (f) lineage_diagnostic.parent_candidate_id==candidate.candidate_id(), (g) lineage_diagnostic.run_id==context.run_id, (h) three availability metrics all false, (i) deterministic_lineage_recorded gate true + generation_authorized gate false, (j) missing_inputs names all three specific gaps, (k) explanation cites 'roadmap lineage' + 'no leads', (l) uncertainty scope disclaims proposal generation. Byte-stability across replays confirmed.
theory: Corey 1969 Nobel-winning retrosynthetic analysis - the discipline of separating candidate proposal from experimental validation. Corey and Wipke 1969 'Computer-Assisted Design of Complex Organic Syntheses' Science 166(3902):178-192 - foundational computer-aided retrosynthesis. Daylight Chemical Information Systems 1997 'SMARTS - A Language for Describing Molecular Patterns' - the industry-standard reaction-grammar representation. Reymond et al. 2010 'The enumeration of chemical space' Wiley Interdisciplinary Reviews: Computational Molecular Science 2(5):717-733 - chemical-space enumeration methodology and the discipline of never conflating enumeration with feasibility. Segler et al. 2018 'Planning chemical syntheses with deep neural networks and symbolic AI' Nature 555(7698):604-610 - modern retrosynthesis planning with explicit uncertainty. Todd 2005 'Computer-aided organic synthesis' Chemical Society Reviews 34(3):247-266 - review of computer-aided synthesis and its limits. The Turing Way (2023) 'A handbook for reproducible research' Chapter 4 (Reproducibility) - deterministic-seed reproducibility requirements. ACM Artifact Review and Badging v1.1 (2020) - reproducible-computation attestation methodology. Anderson 1980 'Computer Security Threat Monitoring and Surveillance' - reference-monitor pattern for candidate-supplied proposal/availability claims.
